name: owner_truth_memory_changeset_groups
summary: Adds immutable, owner-visible V5 ChangeSet dependency groups and root idempotency receipts while retaining existing child formal-memory ChangeSets as the sole fact authority.
operations: create atomic ChangeSet group proposal, member and dependency audit tables
bind group members to existing per-Candidate immutable preview records
create root command receipt storage for idempotent all-or-nothing confirmation
rollback: Disable group-review entry points and retain immutable audit material. Do not remove formal memory versions or child receipts.
